title: Floor underlayment.
officialText:
Particleboard floor underlayment shall conform to Type PBU of ANSI
A208.1. Type PBU underlayment shall not be less than 1/4-inch (6.4 mm) thick and shall be installed in
accordance with the instructions of the Composite Panel Association.
